explain_skill_en: Words that are the same [[kind]] go in one group.
explain_item_en: A [[cat]] and a dog are [[animals]]. Cake and rice are food.
speak_en: Which words are animals, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Put each word with its [[group]].
explain_item_en: [[Red]] and blue are [[colors]]. A pig and a hen are animals.
speak_en: Which words are colors, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Ask what each [[thing]] is. Then sort it.
explain_item_en: [[Bread]] and an egg are [[food]]. A ball and a bike are toys.
speak_en: Which words are food, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Food is something you [[eat]]. A drink is something you sip.
explain_item_en: [[Rice]] and bread are food. [[Milk]] and tea are drinks.
speak_en: Which words are food, and which words are drinks?

explain_skill_en: Think where you [[see]] each thing.
explain_item_en: A [[desk]] and a book are for [[school]]. A cow and a pig live on a farm.
speak_en: Which words belong at school, and which words belong on a farm?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Color words name a [[look]]. Clothes are things you wear.
explain_item_en: [[Green]] and brown are colors. A [[coat]] and a sock are clothes.
speak_en: Which words are colors, and which words are clothes?

explain_skill_en: Look again. People talk and help. Animals walk on [[paws]] or feet.
explain_item_en: A [[cat]] and a dog are animals. [[Mom]] and a teacher are people.
speak_en: Which words are animals, and which words are people?

explain_skill_en: Think when you [[see]] each thing.
explain_item_en: The [[sun]] and lunch belong to [[day]]. The moon and bed belong to night.
speak_en: Which words belong to day, and which words belong to night?

explain_skill_en: Words that are the same [[kind]] go together.
explain_item_en: A [[ball]] and a doll are [[toys]]. A cat and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are toys, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Put fruit with fruit. Put toys with [[toys]].
explain_item_en: An [[apple]] and a banana are [[fruit]]. A ball and a bike are toys.
speak_en: Which words are fruit, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Birds can fly or swim. House things you sit at are one [[group]].
explain_item_en: A [[bird]] and a duck are birds. A [[chair]] and a desk are house things.
speak_en: Which words are birds, and which words are house things?

explain_skill_en: Pets live with you. Fruit is food you [[eat]].
explain_item_en: A [[pet]] and a dog are pets. An [[apple]] and grapes are fruit.
speak_en: Which words are pets, and which words are fruit?

explain_skill_en: Farm animals live in a barn. School things help you [[learn]].
explain_item_en: A [[cow]] and a pig live on a [[farm]]. A book and a pen are for school.
speak_en: Which words belong on a farm, and which words belong at school?

explain_skill_en: Fruit is food you [[eat]]. Balls are things you play with.
explain_item_en: An [[orange]] and an apple are [[fruit]]. A ball and a toy go with balls.
speak_en: Which words are fruit, and which words go with balls?

explain_skill_en: Water animals live in the [[water]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[fish]] and a crab live in water. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are water animals, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Things that [[grow]] outside go in one group. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[tree]] and a flower grow outside. [[Bread]] and rice are food.
speak_en: Which words grow like trees, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Hats go on your [[head]]. Fruit is food you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[hat]] and a cap are hats. An [[apple]] and a banana are fruit.
speak_en: Which words are hats, and which words are fruit?

explain_skill_en: Shoes go on your [[feet]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[shoe]] and a boot are shoes. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are shoes, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Bags hold your [[things]]. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[bag]] and a pack are bags. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are bags, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Bed things help you [[sleep]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[bed]] and a pillow are for sleep. A [[ball]] and a bike are toys.
speak_en: Which words go with beds, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Chairs are for [[sitting]]. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[chair]] and a seat are for sitting. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are chairs, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Books hold a [[story]]. Fruit is food you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[book]] and a story go together. An [[apple]] and a banana are fruit.
speak_en: Which words go with books, and which words are fruit?

explain_skill_en: Cars and buses are things you [[ride]]. Animals walk or run.
explain_item_en: A [[car]] and a bus are for riding. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are cars, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Boats go on [[water]]. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[boat]] and a ship go on water. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words are boats, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Flowers and plants [[grow]] in dirt. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[flower]] and a plant grow outside. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are flowers, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Houses have [[rooms]] inside. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[house]] and a room go together. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words go with houses, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Tables and desks are for [[work]] or eating. Fruit is food.
explain_item_en: A [[table]] and a desk are tables. An [[apple]] and a banana are fruit.
speak_en: Which words are tables, and which words are fruit?

explain_skill_en: Spoons and forks help you [[eat]]. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[spoon]] and a fork help you eat. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are spoons, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Plates and cups hold [[food]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[plate]] and a cup are for eating. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words go with plates, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Cups and glasses hold a [[drink]]. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[cup]] and a glass hold drinks. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are cups, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Parks and yards are places to [[play]] outside. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[park]] and a yard are outside places. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words are parks, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Bikes and carts are things you [[ride]] or push. Fruit is food you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[bike]] and a cart are for moving. An [[apple]] and a banana are fruit.
speak_en: Which words go with bikes, and which words are fruit?

explain_skill_en: Trains and trucks are big things that [[move]]. Animals walk or run.
explain_item_en: A [[train]] and a truck move on land. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are trains, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Clouds and stars live in the [[sky]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[cloud]] and a star are in the sky. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words go with clouds, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Rivers and lakes are [[water]] you can see. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[river]] and a lake are water. A [[ball]] and a kite are toys.
speak_en: Which words are rivers, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Ask what each [[thing]] is and where it lives.
explain_item_en: A [[spoon]] and a fork belong in the [[kitchen]]. A cow and a pig live on a farm.
speak_en: Which words belong in the kitchen, and which words belong on a farm?

explain_skill_en: Clothes are things you [[wear]]. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[shirt]] and a sock are clothes. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words are clothes, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Weather is what the [[sky]] does. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: [[Rain]] and snow come from the sky. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are weather, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Body words name parts of [[you]].
explain_item_en: A [[hand]] and a foot are on your body. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are parts of your body, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Sports are ways you [[move]] and play. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: [[Soccer]] and swim are sports. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words are sports, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Music is what you [[hear]] and play. Toys are for play time.
explain_item_en: A [[song]] and a drum are music. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are music, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: A garden is where plants [[grow]]. School things help you learn.
explain_item_en: A [[garden]] and a plant belong outside. A [[book]] and a pen are for school.
speak_en: Which words belong in a garden, and which words belong at school?

explain_skill_en: Beach words belong by the [[sea]]. Farm animals live in a barn.
explain_item_en: A [[beach]] and sand go together. A [[cow]] and a pig live on a farm.
speak_en: Which words belong at the beach, and which words belong on a farm?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Tools help you [[fix]] things. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[tool]] and a nail are tools. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are tools, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: A snack is a little [[food]] you eat. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[snack]] and a cookie are snacks. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are snacks, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Breakfast is the food you eat in the [[morning]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: [[Breakfast]] and toast are morning food. A [[ball]] and a bike are toys.
speak_en: Which words are breakfast, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Meals are times you [[eat]]. Play is when you have fun.
explain_item_en: [[Lunch]] and dinner are meals. [[Play]] and a game are for fun.
speak_en: Which words are meals like lunch, and which words are for play?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Home is where you [[sleep]]. School is where you learn.
explain_item_en: [[Home]] and a bed go together. A [[book]] and a desk are for school.
speak_en: Which words belong at home, and which words belong at school?

explain_skill_en: Winter is the cold time. Summer is the [[hot]] time.
explain_item_en: [[Winter]] and snow go together. [[Summer]] and the sun go together.
speak_en: Which words belong to winter, and which words belong to summer?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Warm and hot feel the [[same]]. Cold and ice feel chilly.
explain_item_en: [[Warm]] and hot feel warm. [[Cold]] and ice feel cold.
speak_en: Which words feel warm, and which words feel cold?

explain_skill_en: Trees and plants [[grow]] in dirt. Buildings are places people make.
explain_item_en: A [[tree]] and a plant grow outside. A [[house]] and a barn are buildings.
speak_en: Which words are trees, and which words are buildings?

explain_skill_en: Bugs are little animals that [[crawl]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[bug]] and an ant are little bugs. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are bugs, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Pond animals live near [[water]]. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[frog]] and a turtle live near water. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words are pond animals, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Water words are wet. Toys are for [[play]].
explain_item_en: [[Water]] and a lake are wet. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are water, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Garden food grows in the [[ground]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: [[Corn]] and a bean are garden food. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are garden food, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Milk foods come from [[milk]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: [[Cheese]] and milk come from milk. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are milk foods, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Farm animals live in a [[barn]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[cow]] and a pig live on a farm. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words belong on a farm, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Zoo words belong with wild [[animals]]. School things help you learn.
explain_item_en: A [[zoo]] and a bear go together. A [[book]] and a pen are for school.
speak_en: Which words belong at the zoo, and which words belong at school?

explain_skill_en: A playground is a place to [[play]]. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[playground]] and a swing are for play. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words belong at a playground, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Family words name people who [[love]] you.
explain_item_en: [[Mom]] and dad are family. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are family, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Friends are people you [[like]]. Food is what you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[friend]] and a pal are friends. [[Bread]] and an egg are food.
speak_en: Which words are friends, and which words are food?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Job words name what people [[do]] at school.
explain_item_en: A [[teacher]] and a student have school jobs. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are school jobs, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Rooms are parts of a [[house]]. Animals are living friends.
explain_item_en: A [[room]] and a kitchen are rooms. A [[cat]] and a dog are animals.
speak_en: Which words are rooms, and which words are animals?

explain_skill_en: Dishes help you [[eat]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: A [[dish]] and a spoon are for eating. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are dishes, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Cooking makes [[food]]. Play is when you have fun.
explain_item_en: [[Cook]] and bake make food. [[Play]] and a game are for fun.
speak_en: Which words are cooking, and which words are for play?

explain_skill_en: Streets and roads are for [[cars]]. Farm animals live in a barn.
explain_item_en: A [[street]] and a road go together. A [[cow]] and a pig live on a farm.
speak_en: Which words are streets, and which words belong on a farm?

explain_skill_en: A city and a town are busy [[places]]. Farm animals live in a barn.
explain_item_en: A [[city]] and a town go together. A [[cow]] and a pig live on a farm.
speak_en: Which words are cities, and which words belong on a farm?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Sea and lake are big [[water]]. Toys are for play.
explain_item_en: The [[sea]] and a lake are water. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are sea and water, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Sky things are up high. Ground things are under your [[feet]].
explain_item_en: The [[sky]] and a cloud are up high. The [[ground]] and grass are down low.
speak_en: Which words belong in the sky, and which words belong on the ground?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Inside is in a house. Outside is in the [[yard]].
explain_item_en: [[Inside]] and a room are in the house. [[Outside]] and a yard are out of the house.
speak_en: Which words are inside, and which words are outside?

explain_skill_en: Toys are for [[play]]. House things like chairs stay in a room.
explain_item_en: A [[toy]] and a doll are toys. A [[chair]] and a desk stay in a room.
speak_en: Which words are toys, and which words are house things?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Writing tools help you [[draw]] or write. Fruit is food you eat.
explain_item_en: A [[pencil]] and a crayon are for writing. An [[apple]] and a banana are fruit.
speak_en: Which words are pencils, and which words are fruit?

explain_skill_en: Look again. People talk and help. Pets live in your [[home]].
explain_item_en: [[Mom]] and a teacher are people. A [[pet]] and a dog are pets.
speak_en: Which words are people, and which words are pets?

explain_skill_en: Plants [[grow]]. Rocks do not grow.
explain_item_en: A [[plant]] and a tree grow. A [[rock]] and a stone do not grow.
speak_en: Which words are plants, and which words are rocks?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Nature grows outside. Toys are for [[play]].
explain_item_en: A [[tree]] and a flower grow outside. A [[ball]] and a doll are toys.
speak_en: Which words are nature, and which words are toys?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Wild animals live in the woods. Home is where you [[sleep]].
explain_item_en: A [[wolf]] and a fox are wild. [[Home]] and a bed are for living inside.
speak_en: Which words are wild, and which words belong at home?

explain_skill_en: Land is dirt you can [[walk]] on. Water is wet.
explain_item_en: A [[hill]] and land are dry ground. [[Water]] and a lake are wet.
speak_en: Which words are land, and which words are water?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Ground is under your feet. Air is what you [[breathe]].
explain_item_en: The [[ground]] and grass are down low. [[Air]] and wind move above you.
speak_en: Which words belong on the ground, and which words belong in the air?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Cats have soft [[fur]]. Birds have wings.
explain_item_en: A [[cat]] and a kitten are cats. A [[bird]] and a duck are birds.
speak_en: Which words are cats, and which words are birds?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Boy words name boys. Girl words name [[girls]].
explain_item_en: A [[boy]] and a brother are boys. A [[girl]] and a sister are girls.
speak_en: Which words are boys, and which words are girls?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Parents take care of you. Kids are [[little]] people.
explain_item_en: [[Mom]] and dad are parents. A [[kid]] and a child are kids.
speak_en: Which words are parents, and which words are kids?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Grown-ups are big. Kids are [[little]] people.
explain_item_en: A [[man]] and a woman are grown-ups. A [[kid]] and a child are kids.
speak_en: Which words are grown-ups, and which words are kids?

explain_skill_en: Sunny days show the sun. Rainy days bring [[rain]].
explain_item_en: [[Sunny]] and the sun make a bright day. [[Rain]] and a cloud make a wet day.
speak_en: Which words belong to a sunny day, and which words belong to a rainy day?

explain_skill_en: Look again. House things stay in a room. Clothes are things you [[wear]].
explain_item_en: A [[chair]] and a desk stay in a room. A [[coat]] and a sock are clothes.
speak_en: Which words are house things, and which words are clothes?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Ride things move on a road. House things stay in a [[room]].
explain_item_en: A [[car]] and a bus are for riding. A [[chair]] and a desk stay in a room.
speak_en: Which words are ride things, and which words are house things?

explain_skill_en: Fruit is sweet food you [[eat]]. Garden food grows in the ground.
explain_item_en: An [[apple]] and a banana are fruit. [[Corn]] and a bean are garden food.
speak_en: Which words are fruit, and which words are garden food?

explain_skill_en: Meat comes from animals. Plants [[grow]] in dirt.
explain_item_en: [[Meat]] and beef come from animals. A [[plant]] and corn grow in dirt.
speak_en: Which words are meat, and which words are plants?

explain_skill_en: Rocks are hard and do not grow. Plants [[grow]] in dirt.
explain_item_en: A [[rock]] and a stone are hard. A [[plant]] and a tree grow.
speak_en: Which words are rocks, and which words are plants?

explain_skill_en: Look again. A meal is a big sit-down [[eat]] time. A snack is a little bite.
explain_item_en: A [[meal]] and dinner are big eats. A [[snack]] and a cookie are little bites.
speak_en: Which words are meals, and which words are snacks?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Happy words show a big [[smile]]. Sad words show tears.
explain_item_en: [[Happy]] and glad mean a smile. [[Sad]] and cry mean tears.
speak_en: Which words mean happy, and which words mean sad?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Loud words make a big [[sound]]. Quiet words are soft.
explain_item_en: [[Loud]] and shout make a big sound. [[Quiet]] and soft make a little sound.
speak_en: Which words are loud, and which words are quiet?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Fast words mean you go in a [[hurry]]. Slow words mean you take time.
explain_item_en: [[Fast]] and quick mean hurry. [[Slow]] and walk mean take your time.
speak_en: Which words mean fast, and which words mean slow?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Old and new tell about a [[thing]]. Young and baby tell about a little one.
explain_item_en: [[Old]] and new talk about things. [[Young]] and baby talk about little ones.
speak_en: Which words go with old, and which words go with young?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Clean words help you stay neat. Dirty words mean a [[mess]].
explain_item_en: [[Clean]] and wash make things neat. [[Dirty]] and mud make a mess.
speak_en: Which words mean clean, and which words mean dirty?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Wet words have [[water]]. Dry words do not.
explain_item_en: [[Wet]] and rain have water. [[Dry]] and dust do not have water.
speak_en: Which words mean wet, and which words mean dry?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Up is high. Down is [[low]].
explain_item_en: [[Up]] and a hill go high. [[Down]] and the floor are low.
speak_en: Which words mean up, and which words mean down?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Map words name a [[way]] to look.
explain_item_en: [[North]] and east can go together. [[South]] and west go in the other group.
speak_en: Which words go with north, and which words go with south?

explain_skill_en: Spring and summer are the [[warm]] growing times. Fall and winter get cooler.
explain_item_en: [[Spring]] and summer feel warm. [[Fall]] and winter feel cooler.
speak_en: Which words go with spring, and which words go with fall?

explain_skill_en: Look again. School days are in the week. Fun days are the [[weekend]].
explain_item_en: [[Monday]] and Friday are school days. Weekend and [[Saturday]] are fun days.
speak_en: Which words are school days, and which words are weekend days?

explain_skill_en: Look again. Work is a job you [[do]]. Rest is when you stop and sleep.
explain_item_en: [[Work]] and a job mean you are busy. [[Rest]] and sleep mean you stop.
speak_en: Which words mean work, and which words mean rest?
